summary: Play, learn, and create music anytime, anywhere.
description:
Unleash your inner guitarist with Real Guitar!  Whether you're a seasoned pro, just starting out, or simply dream of rocking out, this app puts the power of music at your fingertips.  Strum chords, shred solos, and explore a vast range of acoustic and electric guitars anytime, anywhere.

Learn at your own pace with 100 built-in lessons, covering everything from basic chords to advanced techniques. Jam along with interactive loops in various styles, or write your own hits using the full 22-fret scale and extensive chord library (1500+ chords!).  Real Guitar delivers studio-quality sound and a realistic playing experience, making practice fun and effective.

Features for every guitarist:

* Realistic Acoustic & Electric Guitars:  Experience authentic sounds and responsive gameplay.
* 100 Guitar Lessons:  Master essential techniques and build your skills.
* Interactive Loops: Jam with diverse backing tracks and explore different genres.
* Extensive Chord Library (1500+):  Find any chord you need, instantly.
* Full 22-Fret Scale:  Play everything from intricate solos to powerful riffs.
* Solo & Chord Modes: Switch seamlessly between playing styles.
* Recording Mode: Capture your performances and share them with the world.
* New Instruments Weekly: Discover fresh sounds and expand your sonic palette.
* MIDI Support: Connect your MIDI devices for enhanced control.
* Free to Play:  Start rocking without spending a dime!

Real Guitar is the perfect tool for anyone who loves the guitar.  Download now and start playing!

We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback, so email us at contact@kolbapps.com or follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube for tips on using the app: @kolbapps
